entries.title: Bigger hero, cleaner rail, and every tool opens its real UI inline
bullets: The center is now much larger — a big Loren orb and headline command the screen (responsive clamp sizing), the composer is wider, and the whole hero is truly centered.
Removed the “Ready” checkmark list from the sidebar — the rail is just navigation now (status badges still live on each tool inside the Platform Tools drawer).

Every Platform Tool now opens its REAL working page inline in a conversation — Property Search, Deal Analyzer, Comp & CMA, Market & People Intelligence, CRM, Deal Rooms, Outreach & Voice Agents, AI Contracts, AI Accounting, Vision Studio, Account. No look-alikes; it mounts your actual product page in the thread with an “Open full page” escape hatch.
Each inline tool has a header with its name + build-status badge, and a per-tool error boundary so one tool never breaks the thread.
entries.bench: LorenToolInline mounts 12 real pages inline · larger hero · rail cleaned · tool artifact in session

entries.title: Home redesign — calm ChatGPT-style shell, drawers, orb hero, status badges
bullets: Collapsible sidebar (hamburger); calm centered hero with orb + typewriter; drawers for Platform Tools / Chats / Projects.
Subtle mono icons instead of a dozen gradients; build-status badges (✓ operational, β beta, α alpha).
AI-curated chat titles from the first prompt.
entries.bench: collapsible rail · drawers · orb+typewriter · status badges · AI titles
